notes: Makes the system-wide Clipboard shortcut configurable from Settings while keeping Command-Shift-V on macOS and Control-Shift-V on Windows as the defaults.
Applies a recorded shortcut immediately, persists it across restarts, and keeps the previous working shortcut when another application already owns the new combination.
Supports letters, numbers, F1-F12, arrow keys, Space, and Return with at least one modifier through native macOS and Windows registration.
Publishes the complete default keyboard-shortcut and user-facing settings reference on the website and in both READMEs.
